about.title: A licensed master plumber in Baytown since 2018.
text: MVP Plumbing LLC is a licensed master plumbing company in Baytown, Texas. Justin Hughes started it in 2018. We do residential and commercial service and repair across Baytown, Mont Belvieu and the surrounding area, under Master Plumber License MPL 38224.

We are not the biggest plumbing outfit around here and we are not trying to be. What we offer is a licensed master plumber who will look at your problem, tell you plainly what is wrong, and tell you what we would do if it were our own house. That last part includes the times when the answer is that it does not need fixing yet.

We try to leave houses easier to work on than we found them. In a lot of Baytown houses the tub or shower valve backs onto a closet, so we cut the sheetrock from the closet side and fit an access panel rather than patching it. It costs nothing extra now, and next time anything needs doing back there the plumber opens a panel instead of cutting your wall again.

The same thinking runs through the rest of it: isolation valves on water treatment equipment so it can be serviced without cutting pipe, new sewer pipe anchored into the slab so the backfill cannot create a new belly, and a working shutoff valve and insulation on every above-ground water line repair.
about.imageAlt: An MVP Plumbing technician cutting into a ceiling with a dust extractor to reach a leak

values.title: We tell you when you do not need the work
values.text: We offered a Chambers County customer a camera inspection and then told them that if it were our house we would not bother, because nothing about the job pointed to a bigger problem.

values.title: We price the situation, not the part
values.text: Two customers with the same brand of fixture got opposite recommendations in the same month, because one had a remodel coming and the other did not.

values.title: We answer 24 hours
values.text: Call 832-334-2836 at any hour and you will be talking to the people who do the work.

faqs.q: What is the fastest way to reach you?
faqs.a: Call 832-334-2836. We answer 24 hours. For anything urgent, water you cannot stop, sewage backing up or no water, call rather than texting or filling in a form. A text and a form both wait for someone to read them; the phone does not.

faqs.q: Can I text you instead of calling?
faqs.a: Yes. It is a cell phone, so texts come through on the same number, 832-334-2836, and it is a good way to send a photo of what you are looking at. What we will not do is promise a text gets answered as fast as a call, so if it is urgent, ring us.

faqs.q: Do you charge for an estimate?
faqs.a: Call and describe the job and we will tell you what we need to see. For most work we come out, look at it, and give you a bid before anything is taken apart.

faqs.q: Can you give me a price over the phone?
faqs.a: For some straightforward work, roughly. For anything involving what is behind a wall or under a slab, no, and anyone who does is guessing. We would rather look at it and give you a real number.
Yes, through Acorn Finance. The financing option appears on the estimate we send you, so the first step is asking for a quote.

No. We are a service and repair company, residential and commercial. That includes remodel plumbing, rough-ins, moving supply and drain lines and tub-to-shower conversions, but not ground-up new builds.
Yes. If you need certificates for a commercial job or a property manager's file, ask when you call and we will send them over.
We are a small company. When you call, you are talking to the people who do the work, not a call centre passing a job to whoever is nearest.

faqs.q: What should I have ready when I call?
faqs.a: What is happening, how long it has been happening, and where you are. If a fixture is involved, which one. If it has been worked on before, what was done. That tells us which machine or part to bring, which often saves a second trip.

faqs.q: Do you charge extra for travel?
faqs.a: Ask when you call and we will be straight with you about it. Baytown and Mont Belvieu are home. The further out a job is, the more the travel matters, and we would rather tell you that up front than surprise you on an invoice.
Baytown and Mont Belvieu are home. We work across Chambers County, the east side of Harris County and the bay area, and we travel further for commercial work.

faqs.q: What if I am not happy with the work?
faqs.a: Call us before you write anything. Most problems are fixable, and we would rather fix them. Warranty terms for parts and labor are on your invoice or estimate.

facts.heading: License and permits
facts.text: All work is performed under Texas Master Plumber License MPL 38224. Permits, gas pressure tests, city inspections and water meter relocations are pulled and passed under that license.

facts.heading: What we do not do
items: New construction. We are service, repair and remodel.
Lend our license. A permit pulled under MPL 38224 means we did the work. Contractors ask; the answer is no.
Sell you a camera inspection to prove a pipe works.
Publish an APR. Financing rates and lender criteria change, and a stale number is worse than no number.

facts.heading: Other work we also do
items: Remodel plumbing: rough-ins, moving supply and drain lines, tub-to-shower conversions, fixture sets and coordinating with the other trades
Garbage disposals
Hose bibs with their own shutoff, insulated for winter
Circulator pumps swapped as a component repair rather than a heater replacement
Sprinkler backflow and double-check assemblies, wrapped for winter

items: State, Navien and Noritz tankless water heaters, with other brands serviced

Uponor PEX-a and copper for repipes, with CPVC where the repair calls for it
Viega MegaPress and ProPress cold press fittings on copper, so there is no open flame in an attic

HALO whole-house water conditioners as our standard line, with AquaArmor filtration and traditional salt softeners on request

facts.heading: Insurance and certificates

facts.heading: Warranty
facts.text: Warranty terms for parts and labor are stated on your invoice or estimate. Manufacturer warranties on equipment we install come from the manufacturer, and warranties do not cover damage from misuse, neglect, freezing, work performed by others or conditions outside our control.

facts.text: Leave the building, do not switch anything on or off including light switches, and call CenterPoint or 911 from outside first. We come in once the situation is safe.

facts.text: Baytown and Mont Belvieu are home. We work across Chambers County, the east side of Harris County and the bay area, we also serve Humble and Atascocita, and we travel further for commercial work. Baytown, TX 77523, a service-area business with no walk-in shop.

facts.heading: Updates by text
facts.text: If you would rather have appointment confirmations, arrival notices, estimates and invoices come to your phone than chase them down, ask us to text them. It is not advertising, consent is not a condition of purchase, and you can stop any time by replying STOP.
